---
title: "Schedule"
---

The spine of the course. One session per week. Each row links the slides, the homework
starter repo, and — after the due date — the sample solution.

::: callout-note
## Take-home exam
The exam is a complete **8-step Bayesian analysis**. You see the target in week 1; every week
builds toward it. Released at the end of term via the `exam` repo on the course org.
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This table is BUILT, not typed. Sources of truth:
#   course.yml               -> term dates, org, number of sessions
#   website/slides/weekNN.qmd-> the week's topic (its YAML title)
#   homework/hw-NN/meta.yml  -> homework title + due date
#   website/resources/hw-NN-solution.pdf -> published sample solution
# A link appears as soon as its file exists; the solution link appears only once the due
# date has passed. Nothing to remember to swap on release.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(yaml)

find_root <- function(start = ".") {
  d <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = FALSE)
  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, "course.yml"))) {
    parent <- dirname(d)
    if (parent == d) stop("course.yml not found above ", start)
    d <- parent
  }
  d
}
root   <- find_root()
cfg    <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(root, "course.yml"))
n_wk   <- cfg$sessions$count
first  <- as.Date(cfg$sessions$first_session)
org    <- cfg$github$org

pad  <- function(i) sprintf("%02d", i)
tbd  <- "[]{.schedule-tbd}--"

# --- topic: the deck's own YAML title, minus the "Week N — " prefix ---
topic_of <- function(i) {
  f <- file.path(root, "website", "slides", paste0("week", pad(i), ".qmd"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(tbd)
  ttl <- tryCatch(rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f)$title, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ttl)) return(tbd)
  trimws(sub("^[^—-]*[—-]", "", ttl))
}
slides_of <- function(i) {
  f <- file.path(root, "website", "slides", paste0("week", pad(i), ".qmd"))
  if (file.exists(f)) sprintf("[slides](slides/week%s.html)", pad(i)) else tbd
}

# --- homework: exists on disk => link the template repo; due passed => link the solution ---
hw_meta <- function(i) {
  f <- file.path(root, "homework", paste0("hw-", pad(i)), "meta.yml")
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(yaml::read_yaml(f), error = function(e) NULL)
}
hw_of <- function(i) {
  m <- hw_meta(i)
  if (is.null(m)) return(tbd)
  due <- if (!is.null(m$due)) format(as.Date(m$due), " (due %d %b)") else ""
  sprintf("[hw-%s](https://github.com/%s/hw-%s/generate)%s", pad(i), org, pad(i), due)
}
sol_of <- function(i) {
  m <- hw_meta(i)
  if (is.null(m) || is.null(m$due)) return(tbd)
  pdf <- file.path(root, "website", "resources", sprintf("hw-%s-solution.pdf", pad(i)))
  if (as.Date(m$due) >= Sys.Date()) return("[]{.schedule-tbd}after due date")
  if (!file.exists(pdf)) return("[]{.schedule-tbd}soon")
  sprintf("[solution](resources/hw-%s-solution.pdf)", pad(i))
}

weeks <- seq_len(n_wk)
tab <- data.frame(
  Week     = pad(weeks),
  Date     = format(first + (weeks - 1) * 7, "%d %b"),
  Topic    = vapply(weeks, topic_of,  character(1)),
  Slides   = vapply(weeks, slides_of, character(1)),
  Homework = vapply(weeks, hw_of,     character(1)),
  Solution = vapply(weeks, sol_of,    character(1)),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(tab, align = c("r", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l"))
```

**Homework** links open GitHub's "create from template" page: it makes your own
`hw-NN-<username>` repo. Name it exactly that — the tracker looks for it by name.
